# Listing once is decided identity

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> A list can be listed once exactly where identity among its members is decided, and sums and counts once per member are then one number; laws refuting something need nothing, and laws that sum or count need it only as a local condition.

`listing-once-is-decided-identity` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Identity among a list's members is decided (IdentityDecided l) where for any two members it is decided whether they are the same. s lists l once (ListsOnce s l) where s is without repetition (Distinct) and has the members of l. A list without repetition decides identity among its members (Distinct.identityDecided); where identity among a list's members is decided, some list without repetition has exactly its members (listsOnce_of_decided, constructively by listOnce); so a list can be listed once exactly where identity among its members is decided (listsOnce_iff_decided), and that it can be is never refuted (not_not_listsOnce). Lists without repetition with the same members have the same total of every quantity and the same length (total_eq_of_same, ListsOnce.total_eq, ListsOnce.length_eq); the number of relata a list holds (Numbers) is one number (Numbers.unique) and exists exactly where identity among its members is decided (numbers_iff_decided); repetition only adds (Numbers.le_length, ListsOnce.total_le). A law refuting something wherever a list is listed once refutes it of the list with no premise (not_of_listsOnce); so the laws whose conclusion is a refutation hold of every family however listed (Flow.Dissipative.opens_listing, Flow.Dissipative.finite_taking_not_recurring_listing, Flow.taking_draws_in_listing, Web.generation_not_recurring_listing, Flow.taking_not_recurring_listing), and under balance, dissipation and embodied arising, neither arising nor ceasing recurs in an enumerated world (World.Enumerated, World.Enumerated.not_recurring). Where the commitment is used it is local: a step is enclosed, or enclosed around a family, exactly where some family closed across it has decided identity among its members (Flow.enclosed_iff, Flow.around_iff); a world is finite exactly where it is enumerated and identity among its relata is decided (World.finite_iff); dissipation is dissipation on every closed family read once per member (Flow.dissipative_iff); every census decides identity among what it lists (Listed.identityDecided), and any listing with identity decided gives a census (Listed.of_listing). Repetition is not harmless: in Doubled the flow balances and dissipates, the family listing twice the condition that comes to stand is closed and not dissipated on, and its stock does not fall, while listed once it falls (Doubled.needs_once). No premise.

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No premise: listsOnce_iff_decided, numbers_iff_decided, World.finite_iff, Flow.enclosed_iff, Flow.around_iff and Flow.dissipative_iff are two-way and hold for every list, flow and world.
- Decided is P58's: that a proposition holds or fails is given; excluded middle is not used.
- No existing module is changed: the existing definitions are proved equivalent to their re-founded forms.

P77 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: the zero-premise plan lists among the commitments of the representation that each relatum is listed once and families are without repetition (Distinct; class (b), item 4). As P58 did for decidedness, this finds what the commitment is: identity decided among the members where a sum or count is taken, a local condition. Inventory: 169 declarations in 15 modules use Distinct directly; 30 need no premise, 33 are local conditions of a sum once per member, 31 local conditions of a count of relata, 9 are re-founded by occurrence, and the rest are numbers, tools or witnesses. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): listing once commits to no more than this. See the integration document §101.

## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 85 theorems of Becoming.Listing all have empty axiom reports, among them IdentityDecided, ListsOnce, listsOnce_iff_decided, not_not_listsOnce, listOnce, Numbers, numbers_iff_decided, not_of_listsOnce, World.Enumerated, World.finite_iff, World.Enumerated.not_recurring, Flow.enclosed_iff, Flow.dissipative_iff and Doubled.needs_once. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §101 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

Of the 30 uses needing no premise, 6 are proved as corollaries and the rest classified from their statements; counting relata cannot be made free of a premise; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; no ethical predicate occurs.
